name: manual_53c9ce
claim: GitHub closes a stacked pull request when its base branch is deleted. Retarget the stacked request to main before deleting the base; to recover, restore the base branch, reopen, change the base to main, then remove the restored branch.

decisions.notes: Both stacked drafts closed within seconds of their bases being deleted after merge.

rationale: Both stacked drafts closed within seconds of their bases being deleted after merge.
